Photo 1 shows the top of the same projector, still wrapped in plastic. The 'EPSON' logo is visible, along with a label that appears to say 'EB-G6350' but is partially obscured. There are also some certification marks and a small circular sticker.

Photo 2 shows the rear panel of the projector, still wrapped in plastic. Multiple ports are visible: LAN, HDMI, DisplayPort, VGA, audio, and component video (red, green, blue). The model number 'EB-G6350' is visible on the top edge of the rear panel, near the center.
All photos show the projector wrapped in clear plastic, suggesting it is new or well-protected. The environment appears to be a storage or retail space with other items in the background.
